description: Move an object (frame, line, group) to another layer (Ebene). Pass layer_name or layer_id; with create_if_missing true a missing layer_name is created on top (warning). Members of a group cannot be moved separately (invalid_state; move the group). Fails with invalid_state when the object lies on a locked layer, is itself locked, or the target layer is locked – unlock with set_layer_visibility first. Returns layer_id, layer_name, previous_layer_id, previous_layer_name, layer_created, changed; warns when the target layer is hidden.

create_if_missing.description: Create the layer named layer_name on top when it does not exist. Default false.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

layer_id.description: Layer id from list_layers. Pass either layer_name or layer_id.

layer_name.description: Layer name (Ebene), exact, as list_layers returns it. Pass either layer_name or layer_id.

name: set_frame_layer
title: Move object to a layer
